Name: Audrey Morehead
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Interpreting visual texts would be most immediately usable in my teaching context. I teach social studies, specifically American History, we have interpreted visuals before, but do not do it as often as I would like. There are multiple types of visuals (graphs, charts, political cartoons, ect.) I could bring into my classroom to add depth to a lesson.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I have tried using timed writing stints to engage students throughout the year. It is a challenge to get some students to write for the entire timed stint.
